props.title: Assembled
props.description: Workforce management platform helping organizations scale customer support.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Ryan Wang; Brian Sze; John Wang

props.body:
Assembled is a workforce management platform for customer support teams that provides automation, forecasting, scheduling, real‑time staffing controls and performance analytics. Teams can adjust schedules on the fly, rebalance workloads and keep service levels on track with granular visibility into queues and channels.

The platform integrates with common support and communications tools and offers partner integrations for deployment in existing environments. Solutions span scaling support, capacity planning, intraday management and reporting for data‑driven support operations.

props.title: Banner
props.description: Automating the real estate capital process, from bidding to reporting.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Mark Murphy; Kunal Chaudhary; Eric Gao

props.body:
Banner builds software for real estate owners and developers to manage capital projects end‑to‑end, including bidding, bid leveling, cost tracking, and reporting. It centralizes communications, workflows, and project data so stakeholders can coordinate decisions in one place.

By standardizing the capital process and unifying documentation, Banner aims to deliver projects on time and on budget while maintaining auditability across the lifecycle from acquisition to disposition.

props.title: Basata
props.description: Giving healthcare admin teams superpowers.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Kaled Alhanafi, Chetan Patel, Vivin Paliath

props.body:
Basata offers an end-to-end agentic platform for healthcare administrators, automating the operational workflows that keep practices running — referral processing, intake coordination, call handling and patient follow-up. It replaces fragmented, manual processes with a single system where tasks that once took days, resolve in minutes.

By building directly alongside the administrators doing the work, Basata delivers automation that gets adopted and stays adopted, helping healthcare practices operate more efficiently while reducing the pressure on their most overstretched teams.

props.title: Beeble
props.description: Bringing cutting edge visual effects (VFX) to indie creators.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Hoon Kim; Donghyun Na; Jisoo Lee; Minje Jang; Wonjun Yoon

props.body:
Beeble provides AI‑assisted post‑production tools that extract high‑quality VFX passes and compositing assets from source footage. The system produces outputs such as depth, normals, relighting and other passes to support modern visual effects workflows.

Beeble develops mobile virtual production that allows users to create realistic image compositing. Anyone can turn their green screen videos into a cinematic shots in seconds

props.title: BNTO
props.description: Automating supply chains for new, used and rental fashion.

props.body:
BNTO is the ultimate fashion rental subscription, offering the most coveted styles from both popular and up-and-coming global brands and designers, allowing renters to curate their own monthly BNTO boxes.

BNTO aims to serve consumers seeking coveted, fashion-forward global brands for everyday wear. Renting allows customers to take fashion risks, without high financial stakes. BNTO provides a low-risk way for customers to discover new brands and expand their style boundaries.

props.title: Clearly AI
props.description: Automating security and privacy reviews.

props.body:
Clearly AI is an AI-powered security and compliance co-pilot that automates design reviews, threat modeling, privacy impact assessments, and risk documentation so teams can ship secure products faster without bogging down engineers in manual reviews.

Clearly AI aims to serve security, privacy, and governance teams at fast-moving tech organizations struggling to balance velocity with rigorous risk management. By automating traditionally slow, manual review processes, Clearly AI helps teams catch high-risk issues earlier, reduce backlogs, and maintain audit-ready compliance without sacrificing development speed.

props.title: Cusp
props.description: Foundation models for molecular and materials discovery.

props.body:
CuspAI develops AI systems to accelerate the discovery and design of new materials for applications such as carbon capture and energy. Its platform uses machine‑learning models to search vast materials spaces and propose candidates with target properties.

Cusp's team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

props.title: DataGrail
props.description: Data privacy software simplifying compliance with GDPR and CCPA.

props.body:
DataGrail is a privacy automation platform that helps organizations comply with regulations such as GDPR and CCPA. Capabilities include data discovery and mapping, data subject request workflows, and privacy assessments.

The platform automates processes across systems to reduce risk and provide auditable compliance, with guided workflows and dashboards for privacy teams.

props.title: DataLane
props.description: Growing outbound revenue for businesses selling to SMBs.

props.body:
DataLane is the real-time identity and intelligence platform for local businesses, creating a unified source of truth across fragmented online and offline data. By resolving business identities across platforms, DataLane enables teams to accurately understand, reach, and transact with the real-world economy.

DataLane serves companies that depend on high-confidence data about local businesses—across sales, marketing, underwriting, and operations. By replacing brittle, siloed datasets with a continuously updated identity layer, DataLane reduces risk, improves decision-making, and unlocks reliable access to the offline economy.

props.title: Dataro
props.description: Institutional fundraising platform supercharging development.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Tim Paris; Chris Paver; David Lyndon

props.body:
Dataro provides an AI fundraising intelligence platform for nonprofits that predicts donor behavior and recommends campaigns to improve revenue. Tools include automated prospect research and donor segmentation.

Product features extend to content assistance that drafts appeals and thank‑you notes tailored to audience segments, supporting faster campaign execution for fundraising teams.

props.title: Daydream
props.description: End-to-end automation of programmatic SEO.

props.body:
Daydream automates the creation and implementation of growth marketing playbooks for the world’s fastest growing companies.

The future of growth marketing is one where companies pay for outcomes, rather than tools. Daydream leverages a combination of AI-enabled services and software to execute SEO growth playbooks for companies like Clay, OpenArt, Beacons and dozens of others. They're expanding their capabilities across the entire growth marketing stack, encompassing all essential customer acquisition channels.

props.title: Drata
props.description: Security and compliance automation platform built for enterprise.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Adam Markowitz; Daniel Marashlian; Troy Markowitz

props.body:
Drata is a modern GRC and compliance automation platform that unifies controls, risks, and audits while automating evidence collection. It supports frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA through continuous monitoring and integrations with cloud and SaaS systems.

Organizations use Drata to accelerate security reviews, maintain audit readiness and provide real‑time visibility into compliance posture across teams and environments.

props.title: Elicit
props.description: AI research assistant analyzing the world’s research.

props.body:
Elicit is an AI research assistant that searches, summarizes and extracts data from scholarly literature to help researchers complete reviews and answer technical questions. It provides workflows for screening papers, synthesizing findings, and extracting structured information.

Elicit connects to large academic corpora and supports interactive analysis of thousands of papers, aiming to reduce time spent on manual literature review.

props.title: Entire
props.description: Developer platform built for human and agent collaboration.

props.body:
Entire is building the world’s next developer platform where humans and AI agents collaborate together. Entire serves developers and engineering teams looking to get the most out of their agents, without sacrificing speed or quality.

Their first product, Entire Rewind, is an open source tool that captures agent sessions in Git on every push. Rewind makes it easy to look back at any historical commit with full context to reproduce or fix prior results.

props.title: Ergeon
props.description: Transforming home improvement with automation from design to delivery.

props.body:
Ergeon is a technology‑enabled home services company focused on outdoor projects such as fences, gates, concrete driveways, patios and artificial grass.

Customers receive remote estimates, standardized packages and managed installations. Online tools and guided workflows span design selection, transparent pricing and project scheduling, with service offerings covering multiple materials and configurations.

props.title: Farmwise
props.description: Autonomous weeding helping farmers reach productivity and profitability goals.

props.body:
FarmWise builds AI and computer‑vision equipment for precision weeding in specialty crops. Their team is enabling growers to rethink farming operations with machines and technology that can perceive, understand, and act on each and every plant in real-time.

FarmWise released its Vulcan precision implement in 2023. Vulcan is a unique intra-row weeder and precision cultivator designed for durability and efficient weeding.

props.title: FerretDB
props.description: Open Source MongoDB alternative, built on Postgres.

props.body:
FerretDB is developing an open source, MongoDB-compatible document database. Their solution lets users interact with FerretDB just like as if it would be MongoDB.

FerretDB is based on Postgres and SQLite. FerretDB allows you to use MongoDB drivers seamlessly with PostgreSQL as the database backend.

props.title: Flint
props.description: Personalized learning built for schools.

props.body:
Flint is an AI-powered learning platform designed for K–12 schools that personalizes education for every student.Built in collaboration with educators, Flint helps teachers adapt lessons in real time, engage every learner and foster creativity across subjects — from math and science to world languages and writing.

With Flint, students can explore interactive simulations, get instant writing feedback, practice languages through conversation, code alongside AI collaborators and even design their own projects — all while teachers track progress and tailor instruction to each student’s needs.

props.title: Hallway
props.description: 3D Avatars that extend the digital identities of creators.

props.body:
Hallway develops a virtual‑camera app that lets people appear as animated avatars anywhere.

Avatars are a reflection of our true selves, allowing people to choose how they present themselves to the world. Hallway combines AI and ML with off-the-shelf hardware to empower 3D content and creativity for artists, fans, and creators. This marriage between art and technology enables an entirely new set of online experiences. Hallway aims to radically democratize access to creating a customizable digital presence for a new generation of creators.

props.title: Imbue
props.description: AI agents that can reason and code.

props.body:
Imbue builds AI systems and tools that make software creation accessible so individuals can create, modify and control the software and agents they use. The company focuses on computing tools that give people more direct agency over AI systems.

Its research explores approaches for building reliable, controllable AI, and product work centers on enabling end users to develop and run powerful software and agents for personal and professional workflows.

props.title: Internet Backyard
props.description: Financial operations for data centers.

props.body:
Internet Backyard is building the financial backbone of the compute economy -- automating quoting, billing, payments and financial workflows for compute providers, enabling scalable, transparent, and tradable compute supply.

As AI demand accelerates, compute is becoming one of the most valuable resources on Earth, yet the financial infrastructure around it remains fragmented, manual, and slow. Internet Backyard is building the future financial infrastructure for AI.

props.title: Leaping AI
props.description: Automating complex call centers with voice AI.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Kevin Wu; Arkadiy Telegin; Shraey Bhatia

props.body:
Leaping AI provides enterprise voice agents for automating call center operations. Its agents handle common customer interactions, integrate with policy and account systems and hand off to humans when needed.

The platform offers prebuilt conversation flows, a no‑code interface for deployment and post‑call analytics that continuously improve agent performance.

props.title: Mem0
props.description: Memory for LLMs, enabling rapid deployment of personalized apps.

props.body:
Mem0 is a memory infrastructure platform that gives AI applications the ability to remember, retrieve, and evolve information across interactions. The platform provides developers with APIs and SDKs for storing and syncing user context across models, agents, and environments, enabling persistent and personalized AI experiences.

Compatible with frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex, Mem0 automates memory management through tools for context retrieval, summarization, and relevance ranking. Its model-agnostic design works with both proprietary and open-source LLMs, helping developers build applications that learn from history — like assistants that recall prior conversations, copilots that understand user preferences, and agents that adapt over time.

By abstracting complex state management into a unified memory layer, Mem0 simplifies development and accelerates the creation of context-aware AI systems.

props.title: Momentum
props.description: Automating sales workflows and improving time to close for every deal.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Santiago Suarez Ordoñez; Ashley Wilson; Moiz Virani

props.body:
Momentum is an AI‑native revenue orchestration platform that turns conversations and meetings into structured go‑to‑market data. It updates CRM fields in real time and synchronizes information across tools to improve pipeline visibility and reporting.

Products include a deal execution agent that automates post‑call administration — saving notes, updating Salesforce, drafting follow‑ups — and workflow automation for deal desk approvals via Slack and other systems.

props.title: Neion
props.description: A Better Way to Make Medicine.

props.body:
Neion Bio uses genetic engineering to produce medicines in chicken eggs instead of massive industrial factories, dramatically lowering the cost of drug manufacturing.

Their platform turns eggs into efficient, self-contained drug factories capable of producing therapeutic proteins at a fraction of traditional costs. As drug shortages rise and manufacturing bottlenecks persist, Neion offers a faster, cheaper, and more resilient way to make life-saving medicines in America.

props.title: Norm
props.description: Regulation-aware AI agents built for compliance teams.

props.body:
Norm builds regulatory AI agents that deliver proactive compliance checks inside enterprise workflows. The agents evaluate proposed content or actions against relevant laws and firm policies and explain the basis for each determination.

The platform provides a regulatory knowledge layer and APIs so teams can embed compliance oversight into automated processes, reducing review cycles while maintaining risk controls.

props.title: Nuro
props.description: Pioneer in AI-first autonomy, revolutionizing mobility for all.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Alden Woodrow; Nancy Sun; Jur van den Berg

props.body:
Nuro is transforming everyday life by bringing the power of AI into the physical world with its fully autonomous Nuro Driver.

In December 2020, Nuro acquired Basis Set portfolio company Ike, integrating its self‑driving truck efforts with Nuro’s broader autonomous vehicle technology programs.

props.title: OpenArt
props.description: Comprehensive visual storytelling platform, redefining who can create.

props.body:
OpenArt is a platform dedicated to AI art enthusiasts. For a very long time in human history, art was a specialized technique mastered by minority. However, the foundation of art is all about expressing creativity and imagination, which is something everyone should be empowered to do.

With the state-of-the-art technologies like Stable Diffusion, creating amazing art is more accessible to everyone than ever and AI-generated art is becoming a new way to express ourselves. OpenArt empowers anyone to create.

props.title: Parasail
props.description: Faster GPU clouds at 1/5th the price, coupled with LLM deployments.

props.body:
Parasail is a scalable, high-performance AI compute platform designed to make inference fast, cost-effective and infrastructure-free. The platform lets AI teams move from prototype to production without DevOps bottlenecks, with access to serverless endpoints, dedicated instances and batch pipelines powered by high-end GPUs.

The platform integrates with open-source model ecosystems and offers self-service deployment via API, without long-term contracts or vendor lock-in. Solutions span rapid prototyping, production-ready inference at scale, batch processing for large token workloads and cost-optimized hardware matching based on speed-vs-cost goals.

props.title: Path
props.description: Autonomous welding and manufacturing robots.

props.body:
Path Robotics develops autonomous robotic welding systems that use computer vision and AI to fit, adapt and weld parts without manual programming. Path helps manufacturers navigate skilled labor shortages, to increase production and scale their businsses.

The Path system scans and creates a 3D model of each part. It analyzes data on the fly to understand each part individually and creates optimal robotic paths and part positioning to produce high-quality welds.

props.title: Quill
props.description: Private and secure enterprise knowledge.

props.body:
Quill is an AI-driven meeting intelligence and workflow automation platform that captures detailed notes, identifies key insights and drives meaningful follow-ups across teams’ everyday conversations. Rather than just transcribing, Quill organizes discussions into structured summaries, highlights blockers and automatically generates action items, tasks and contextual outputs that integrate with users’ tools and processes.

Built with a privacy-first approach and localized processing, Quill keeps sensitive meeting data secure while helping professionals stay aligned, reduce post-meeting workload and turn spoken conversation into executable work — from weekly recaps and CRM updates to prioritized to-dos and searchable historical context.

props.title: Quince
props.description: Democratizing luxury goods through its direct and automated supply chain.

props.body:
Quince is democratizing high-quality fashion. The company's ultra-efficient supply chain and cutting-edge technology allows it to offer products at much lower prices than competing brands.

Quince is vertically integrated to maximize efficiency, providing value across its entire supply chain from raw materials and manufacturing through consumption.

props.title: Rasa
props.description: Conversational AI software for building text and voice-based assistants.

props.body:
Rasa provides open‑source and commercial software for building conversational assistants in text and voice. Developers design pipelines for intent classification, entity extraction, dialogue management, and integration with messaging channels.

The company also offers Rasa Pro and design paradigms such as CALM for deploying reliable LLM‑native assistants in production environments.

props.title: Reflow
props.description: View, Optimize, Automate Enterprise Operations.

props.body:
Reflow is an enterprise workflow intelligence platform that makes operational work observable by turning complex human and system workflows into structured data, helping leaders visualize where work actually happens, identify bottlenecks, and measure the ROI of automation and optimization.

Reflow aims to serve enterprise operations and AI automation leaders who struggle to understand how work flows across systems and teams. By providing real-time visibility into workflows and actionable insights on what to automate and why, Reflow helps organizations make data-driven decisions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure automation investments pay off.

props.title: Reve
props.description: Transforming cinematic production, from concept and scripting to final cuts.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Christian Cantrell, Michaël Gharbi, Taesung Park, Jon Watte, Mike Speiser

props.body:
Reve is a multimodal image creation and editing platform that replaces complex toolchains with an AI-powered workflow centered on creative intent instead of technical mastery. Users can generate, remix and refine visuals with natural language, or dive into pixel-level control through a direct-manipulation editor that exposes and edits the model’s internal layout representation. This enables rapid iteration, precise adjustments, and seamless blending of text, references, and uploaded images into a unified creative process.

The platform integrates best-in-class visual models, a conversational creative assistant and an API for embedding image generation and editing into third-party applications. Powered by an intermediate code-like visual language that bridges text and vision, Reve delivers precision editing, consistent character likeness, and structured object-level control.

props.title: Rowspace
props.description: Specialized intelligence for investors to make faster, sharper decisions.

props.body:
Rowspace is an AI platform that helps investment and financial services firms turn fragmented proprietary data into structured, decision-ready intelligence. The system unifies memos, models, deal records, accounting systems and unstructured archives, reconciles inconsistencies and embeds a firm-specific reasoning layer that mirrors how teams actually think and make decisions.

Teams can access trusted institutional knowledge across workflows—whether in native dashboards, Excel, collaboration tools or existing data stacks—and use it for portfolio monitoring, deal evaluation, risk analysis and other mission-critical decisions with full traceability of sources and conclusions. Rowspace deploys into customer environments to keep data secure and accelerate high-stakes financial decision-making at scale.

props.title: Sakana
props.description: Research lab creating nature-inspired AI.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: David Ha; Llion Jones; Ren Ito

props.body:
Sakana AI is a research company developing nature‑inspired methods for training and improving foundation models in Japan. Sakana AI continues to push the frontiers of AI innovation, devising new techniques for more efficient foundation model development.

Sakana AI brings experience in conducting AI research to the table, in addition to an acute understanding of Japan’s unique domestic needs to enhance model development.

props.title: Seen Health
props.description: Full-stack senior care, improving health outcomes with end-to-end technology.

props.body:
Seen Health is an AI-powered PACE platform that unifies medical care, home-based services, social programs and transportation through intelligent scheduling, predictive insights and automated follow-ups. Staff receive real-time visibility into participant needs, enabling proactive interventions and smoother coordination across clinical and community settings.

The platform connects EHR data, caregiver workflows, logistics systems and communication channels, resulting in more optmized care-plans and culturally attuned support models that unlock more efficient, high-quality aging-in-place.

props.title: Simular
props.description: Personal AI agents on digital devices.

props.body:
Simular develops AI agents that can perceive screens, reason about tasks and act on a user’s computer. The product includes an AI browser‑automation experience for operating desktop apps and websites.

Simular ranked #1 in OSWorld Computer Use Benchmark, and received the Best Paper Award in ICLR 2025 Agentic AI for Science workshop.

props.title: Single Origin
props.description: Optimizing SQL semantics with one-click.

props.body:
Single Origin is an AI-powered data semantic platform in multi/hybrid cloud that reduces compute and storage while boosting productivity at scale. It unlocks unique insights of column usage and inter-query patterns powered by its proprietary query compiler and parser.

The platform dedupes, optimizes and simplifies queries and tables via algebra and machine learning and guardrails new queries for efficiency and governance.

props.title: Slope
props.description: B2B payments infrastructure and access to capital through AI underwriting.

props.body:
Slope is a B2B payments platform that provides embedded capital and a reusable line of credit for buyers. Businesses can offer net terms and installments while accepting online payments through software and APIs.

Financial services and order‑to‑cash automation are packaged for enterprise marketplaces and wholesalers, including instant approvals and capital draws for inventory purchases.

props.title: Snappr
props.description: Democratizing professional visual content for every business.

props.body:
Snappr is a visual content platform that provides on‑demand professional photography, high‑volume editing and automated content workflows for businesses.

Snappr is making visual content accessible to everyone. They take on complex problems so that photographers, consumers and businesses can connect in more than 250 cities around the world to create and access beautiful visual content. Their AI delivers photorealistic, brand-aligned images in seconds, filling gaps that traditional photography can’t.

props.title: Solvely.ai
props.description: AI agents for learning to deliver adaptive, personalized, and joyful education.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Du Zhang; Enpeng Yuan (Nick); Richard Weiqi Zhang

props.body:
Solvely is an AI study companion that provides step‑by‑step solutions to homework problems from photos or typed input across subjects from K‑12 to graduate level.

Covering math, science, liberal arts, and economics, Solvely's advanced AI solver equips students to conquer challenges across various disciplines with ease, increasing motivation and removing cognitive blockers.

props.title: Spice
props.description: All-in-one modular and scalable AI infrastructure.

props.body:
With Spice AI, developers no longer need to be data or AI/ML experts to build intelligent, data and AI-driven software. We are helping every developer utilize and compose the latest AI/ML technology and infrastructure, so they can build the next generation of applications.

By providing core building blocks for creating data and AI-driven applications: data, models, search, retrieval, and AI inference, Spice AI delivers everything teams need within one, interconnected, developer-focused AI runtime.

props.title: Spuree
props.description: Animation tools powered by character performance foundation models.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Michael LoFaso, Hubert Tsai, Wei-Cheng Kuo

props.body:
Spuree is an AI-powered animation platform that streamlines production workflows by automating storyboarding, character and asset creation, motion stylization, rendering prep and scene composition. Creators can iterate on shots in real time, test alternative takes instantly and move fluidly between tools without manual conversions and cleanup.

The platform combines in-house models with third-party AI systems to accelerate prototyping while preserving creative control. It integrates directly into existing studio pipelines, supporting data annotation, cross-tool consistency and rapid scene updates. Spuree reduces production cost and complexity while enabling both studios and independent creators to bring animation to life faster.

props.title: Talofa
props.description: Universal infrastructure for gamified fitness experiences.

props.body:
Talofa Games builds fitness games that connect real‑world movement to gameplay. Run Legends turns walking or running into cooperative battles and progression in a mobile RPG experience.

Talofa is an award-winning studio passionate about blending wellness with engaging game design. They're creating novel experiences to help players be healthier, while having more fun with fitness.

props.title: Thinking Machines
props.description: Transformative AI products pushing the boundary of possibility.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Mira Murati; John Schulman; Barrett Zoph; Lilian Weng; Andrew Tulloch; Luke Metz

Thinking Machines Lab is an AI research startup developing advanced multimodal systems. The team is building a future where everyone has access to the knowledge and tools to make AI work for their unique needs and goals.

The founding team is made up of scientists, engineers and builders who’ve created some of the most widely used AI products, including ChatGPT and Character.ai, open-weights models like Mistral, as well as popular open source projects like PyTorch, OpenAI Gym, Fairseq, and Segment Anything.

props.title: Tigris Data
props.description: Globally distributed, S3-compatible, object storage service.

stats.label: Founders
stats.value: Ovais Tariq; Evgeny Firsov; Himank Chaudhary

props.body:
Tigris provides globally distributed, S3‑compatible object storage designed for low‑latency access and AI workloads, with multi‑cloud buckets and zero‑egress pricing documented in its developer materials.

In the age of AI, storage isn’t just where data sits— it’s the foundation every workload runs on. Tigris is designed to keep up with the most demanding workflows: training at scale, low-latency inference anywhere, and safe collaboration for agents working in parallel.

props.title: Verge
props.description: Discovering treatments for neurodegenerative disease with AI.

props.body:
Verge Genomics is a biotechnology company using an AI‑enabled, all‑in‑human discovery platform to identify drug targets and candidates directly from human data.

The company is led by experienced computational biologists and drug developers who are successfully advancing clinical and preclinical therapeutic programs in various diseases, including ALS and Parkinson’s disease.

props.title: Vizcom
props.description: Product design platform enabling designers to bring their visions to life.

props.body:
Vizcom is a creative tool for design teams that turns sketches into rendered concepts and 3D models for rapid iteration. Designers can generate models from drawings and view concepts in AR or export for 3D printing.

Collaboration features help teams at enterprises from Ford to New Balance stay aligned and move faster during concept development, supporting workflows from ideation to presentation.

props.title: Workstream

Workstream provides hiring, HR, scheduling, and payroll software for businesses with hourly workforces. The platform streamlines applicant sourcing, communication, and onboarding in a mobile‑first experience.

Organizations like Taco Bell, IHOP and Burger King use Workstream to reduce time‑to‑hire and consolidate HR operations for multi‑location teams across restaurants, retail, and other local services.

props.title: AI Agents Are Rewriting the Rules of Developer Infrastructure
props.description: AI agents are forcing a rethink of core developer infrastructure—from secure sandboxes and browser automation to agent-native databases.

About Basis Set

At Basis Set, we invest in exceptional people early.

We’ve been backing AI companies since 2017, before ChatGPT was a household name.

The Basis Set AI Fellows program is for early-career builders ready to become stronger operators in the next era of computing. This program is designed to help you build the range to operate more cross-functionally inside the most ambitious AI companies.

Basis Set AI Fellows

Built for people at a career inflection point, especially:

  • Technical candidates who want stronger product, customer, and business judgment
  • Product, business, and operations candidates who want to become more technical

The goal is the same: help you become someone who can connect product, engineering, and strategy inside high-growth AI companies. If you’re ambitious, high-agency, and want to grow into a more cross-functional operator, this program is designed for you.

What You Get

  • Mentorship from portfolio company CEOs and experienced operators
  • A cohort of exceptional peers
  • Fast-tracked full-time opportunities
  • Access the Basis Set platform as you explore and build, with 1:1 guidance from our team

Select Project Fellows also get:

  • Paid, embedded project work at some of the fastest growing AI companies
  • Co-working space in San Francisco

What You'll Do

Solve hard problems. Work through the kind of messy, ambiguous challenges AI-native startups face, not textbook cases. Break problems down from first principles using the same frameworks we use to evaluate founders and companies. Learn unfamiliar technologies fast and ship real solutions.

Build with AI. Prototype with LLMs, agents, embeddings, and the latest frameworks. Stress-test new products. Build scrappy demos that inform real investment and product decisions.

Operate like a generalist. Move across engineering, product, research, and market analysis. Communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences. Work closely with portfolio teams and the Basis Set investment team.

Three Pathways After the Fellowship

  1. Join a portfolio company: Fast-tracked offers at 100+ companies like Quince, Mem0, and OpenArt
  2. Start a company: Apply to the Basis Set Fellows Fund for dedicated pre-seed funding
  3. Stay connected: Lifetime access to the Basis Set alumni network, founders, investors, and future cohorts

Who This Is For

If you're resourceful, curious, and want to take on more responsibility than your title suggests, this is for you.

  • First-principles thinker — can solve almost any problem given time and tools
  • High agency — figures things out without waiting for instructions
  • Fast learner — ramps quickly in new domains
  • Impact-driven — takes on responsibility early

We care about exceptional signal, not resume credentials. We’re especially excited to meet self-directed learners who push projects forward without being asked and AI-native builders with shipped side projects!

We welcome applications from candidates who are in their final year of undergraduate or graduate study, or who expect to graduate soon.

Program Details

  • 12 weeks — mid-June to early September 2026
  • San Francisco — in person [with select exceptions where company matches may be elsewhere]
  • Applications close May 8, 2026

props.title: Can Large Language Models (LLMs) predict founder success?
props.description: We published our first research report outlining the founder traits most associated with company success a few years ago. In the last few months, we have experimented with using LLMs to try to predict company outcomes, based on founder psychology alone (yes, we know there are 1000 other variables).

props.body:
Can LLMs predict the future for startups? Sounds impossible, but is it? We published our first research report outlining the founder traits most associated with company success a few years ago.

By using founder psychology attributes as the only inputs, the outcomes predicted by the model had a moderately positive correlation to our actual portfolio financial performance (IRR & MOIC).

props.title: Basis Set FAQ
props.description: Basis Set is an early stage venture capital fund based in San Francisco, California. Basis Set invests in founders that are scaling human potential with artificial intelligence.

items.question: Who are you?
items.answer: Basis Set is an early stage venture capital fund based in San Francisco, California. Basis Set invests in founders that are scaling human potential with artificial intelligence.

items.question: What do you look for in founders?
items.answer: Founders are the rarest and most important ingredients in company success. Yet for all their importance, they are most often misunderstood.

items.question: What do you typically invest in?
items.answer: We invest in artificial intelligence and founders harnessing it to improve productivity across all sectors of the economy. We take the long view that AI is the single most transformative force shaping the 21st century.

items.question: What is your process?
items.answer: Our process is your process. We empathize deeply with the undesirable distraction that a fundraise can be for the strongest founders who are product and customer obsessed.

items.question: Why do you have engineers on staff? What is Pascal?
items.answer: We believe the best way to find and support AI companies is by being one ourselves.

items.question: How do you typically support founders?
items.answer: Investments are built on emotional trust and we owe you our complete conviction and unwavering support.

items.question: What is your typical check size?
items.answer: Basis Set invests in pre-seed through Series A businesses with checks ranging from as little as a few hundred thousand to over $9 million dollars.

items.question: What is your fund size? Are you actively investing?
items.answer: Yes, we are actively making new investments. We manage approximately $600 million in assets across three funds. We are currently investing out of our third fund. It is a $185 million dollar fund.

items.question: What do your founders say about you? Do you have any references?
items.answer: Basis Set is a group of very smart, talented, high conviction investors. I think they have a very good knack for people and they’re willing to bet on big ideas.

items.answer: See every company we have backed on our portfolio page.
